harness_commits.016dce05: a ghost run restores its carrier's macros; time.snapshot reports the true multiplier
harness_commits.07c27dc4: the store probe formats tiny magnitudes with tostring (Kahlua %g hangs below 1e-292)

meta.staging: python tools/release_pack.py stage mod/NutritionRevamp --out release/plan11-x39 at 513778e8 (Plan 11b Task 2); no instrument added
meta.seams_note: Every ghost run, in every loaded arm, runs the writer dry (W.dry) and skips the store step for ghost names (S.skip = H0.isGhost), set inside H0.work, which every scheduler calls (Plan 11a ruling 15).
meta.batching_note: burst times its 58 ghost runs in one batch at the minute event; mod keeps one batch open across a drain's contiguous ghost runs and closes it at a real player's run, a task or the drain's end (H0.modRun, H0.modWrap).
meta.carrier_note: Since 016dce05 H0.work restores the carrier's four vanilla macro stores after each ghost run and seeds the ghost record's reconcile baseline from them.
meta.format_note: Since 07c27dc4 TK.SP.text formats a nonzero |v| < 1e-280 with tostring: Kahlua's string.format('%.17g') never returns below about 1e-292 and froze x391g's server.
meta.latency_note: A networked eat ends in real ms (maxTime x 20 ms, about 4640 ms) whatever the multiplier; the loaded arms read the load that lands inside that window.
meta.spawn_note: The apples are spawned by RCON additem (reaches the client) and confirmed by the server's item.get (an id); inventory.add is server-only and would leave the client to spawn an apple the server never heard of (#2917).
meta.probe_note: store.probe bench prices F.intact and F.write on a synthetic eight-double record's text (its bytes in the reply), not the encode F.save runs before them: usPerWrite (and write+intact) is a lower bound on a real slot save, no encode, synthetic record (ruling T2-5).
meta.cost_note: Every server reading is cost, not behaviour: the ghosts run copies of the real records against the two real IsoPlayers. The two real players stay on the mod's own drain.
meta.timer_note: getTimestampMs is 1 ms resolution: a frame's busy is a 1 ms reading; every per-run cost is a total over many runs divided by their count.

deviations: PROFILE x39-shootout-h, PREFIX x391h, ARTIFACT bench.json; no TKX_StudyFoods and no verify row for it.

D1, D2: a ping after any server step that times out (no pong: abort, every later server step skipped, go to Z); the wall budget BUDGET_S 840 with PHASE_EST_S, checked before each phase and each latency poll.

D8: the apples are spawned by RCON additem and confirmed by the server's item.get (an id) before the arm is armed, not by inventory.add (server-only: the client would spawn an apple the server never heard of, #2917); item.get also read before the spawn and after the eats.
D3: P's clear only on a pong; otherwise recorded as skipped (bus dead).
D4: P's failure note carries error, err, reason or raw.
D5: MULT falsified only by a measured trueMult off 1; a null read is unmeasured, or void with a dead bus.
D6: LAT void unless the arm's ping after answered pong and its apples were confirmed and the arm armed; Lidle's median graded against LIDLE_MEDIAN_BAND.
D7: Z also requires its players read to answer a list.
D9: INTAKE_LANDED read before and after each L arm, graded as LAND (+3).
D10: HARNESS_MARKERS holds 07c27dc4's %g guard beside 016dce05's three carrier markers; HARNESS_COMMITS records both and both must be ancestors of HEAD.
D11: part 3 (SEED and Gmod) dropped with its constants and verdicts; F and CARRIER read I only; S and SEAM read Lburst and Lmod.
S0 adds a ping; PROBE_RX also excludes item.get.

Pre-run edits after the review of a77e3f3b: an L arm is void with a leftover apple before its spawn; the landed poll and apple2 read moved after ring_read and perf_read (drop_windows unchanged); PROBE falsified on a failed save with a live bus; a standalone ping with no pong sets the bus dead; Z takes its local readings before its server steps.
